rationale: To improve the recommendation system for H&M, we focus on customer purchasing behavior over the past 30 days. We include features such as recent transactions, purchase frequency, product diversity, average transaction value, and club membership status to predict purchases in the next 7 days. These features are designed to capture a customer's shopping habits and preferences accurately.

derived.name: f_recent_transactions
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_avg_days_ago < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_high_frequency_customer
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_total_transactions > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_diversified_purchases
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_unique_products > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_expensive_customers
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_avg_price > 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_club_member
derived.sql: CASE WHEN raw_u_club_member_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
